fresno-01.justificacion: Maintains the existing practice. It is the comparison baseline, not an automatic improvement.
fresno-01.incertidumbre: Satellite data and yield indicators are not measurements from this individual field.
fresno-01.validacion: Check irrigation, fertilization, yield and observed rotation records with the grower.

fresno-01.justificacion: Explores a lower-water-demand primary crop and cover to limit soil exposure.
fresno-01.incertidumbre: Water balances, yields and planting windows are hypothetical and depend on local soil, irrigation and climate.
fresno-01.validacion: Validate water availability, viable planting dates, salinity, market access and available machinery.

fresno-01.justificacion: Simulates legumes and cover crops to diversify rotations and explore nitrogen contributions.
fresno-01.incertidumbre: Nitrogen fixation and gross revenue are not guaranteed; field trials and actual USDA Market News prices are still needed.
fresno-01.validacion: Measure available nitrogen, organic matter, salinity and compaction; confirm crop contracts and prices.
